hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_RH
hook.description: A shared fee hook for Moonsend token pools that sets immutable per-pool dynamic LP fees (1.25%–10.25%) via updateDynamicLPFee on afterInitialize, and applies an optional anti-sniper buy-side fee (~99%) for a creator-chosen 5–10 second window post-launch. Only factory-registered pools are served; sells are never taxed during the window.
